note: Studio-managed patches to installer-owned BMad files. Each is the smallest fix for a named upstream defect, pinned to the exact upstream text and core versions it was verified against; tk install re-applies it after every install, tk activate reports it missing, and a changed upstream text or an undeclared core version makes it stale instead of patching blind. Retire a patch when its upstream issue is fixed at the pin.
